breaking_changes.BC_description: Calling getState, subscribe, or unsubscribe while a dispatch is in progress (including from within a reducer) will now throw an error. In previous versions, this was permitted (though discouraged), but in v4.0.0 it will lead to a runtime exception.

Direct imports of internal Redux modules (e.g., 'redux/lib/createStore') will no longer work due to changes to module bundling. Only public exports from the main entry point (e.g., 'redux') are now supported. This affects both CommonJS and ES module builds.
Removed legacy 'jsnext' entry from package. Any build or tooling relying specifically on the 'jsnext:main' field in Redux's package.json will no longer detect a JSNext module entry point.
